book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Te Rono Tauareka Luk e taataa

content: Te sipsip ni rano
Teeraa he aho, e tammaki na tama e aoao na takis ia ma na tama hai ssara e oo ake ma ki hakallono na tattara Jisas raa.
Tena na Farisi ia ma na tama poroporo na tuaa raa ku tamumu ma, “Tama nei e hihai na tama hai ssara, ia e kaikkai hoki ma na tama raa.”
Kito Jisas ki tattara ake na tama raa te tattara hurihuri nei:

“Kame he tama kootou e isi huitarau na sipsip, tena he sipsip hokotahi ku rano. Hea akoe e me ki pena? Akoe e me ki tiaki na sipsip tipu sivo ma sivo raa ki kaikkai, tena akoe e me ki haere no sesee te sipsip hokotahi e rano raa te saaita roo akoe e lave te manu raa.
Te saaita akoe ku lave te sipsip raa, akoe e me ki hihia roo no hakapiri te sipsip raa i te panaua akoe

no amo i hare. Tena akoe e me ki kanna ake na soa akoe ia ma na tama e illoa akoe raa hakaatoa, tena ku tattara ake na tama raa ma, ‘Anau e hihia roo e mee anau ku lave te sipsip anau ni rano raa. Oo mai taatou ki hihhia hakaatoa!’

Anau e meatu kootou pera ma e me ki ssau peeraa hoki, kame he tama hokotahi e tike i taha ma na hai sara aia, na ensel i te vaelani raa e me ki hihhia roo, e raka i aruna ma te tipu sivo ma sivo na tama e ttonu tahi tera se tau te ttike i taha ma na hai sara laatou raa.
Te sileni ni rano

“Kame he hine e isi sanahuru na siliva, tena he siliva hokotahi ku rano. Hea te hine raa e me ki pena? Te hine raa e me ki hakaura te lamu raa no verevere te hare raa, tena ku sesee hakaraoi roo na kina hakaatoa ki lave roo aia te siliva raa.

Te saaita aia e lave te siliva raa, te hine raa e me ki kanna ake na soa ia ma na tama e illoa aia raa hakaatoa, tena ku meake, ‘Anau e hihia roo e mee anau ku lave te siliva anau ni rano raa. Taatou ki hihhia hakaatoa!’
Anau e meatu kootou pera ma e me ki ssau peeraa hoki, na ensel i te vaelani raa e me ki hihhia roo kame he tama hai sara hokotahi e tike i taha ma na hai sara aia.”
Te haanau ni llano
Tena Jisas ki tattara ake hoki, “Teeraa he tama e isi e rua na taupeara.
Taupeara paamee raa e meake te tamana aia raa ma, ‘Kou mai te tuhana anau raa vahao nei.’ Kito te tamana tokorua raa ki vvae i lottonu na hekau raa ma na taupeara e rua aia raa.

Tena na aho i muri raa koi, te taupeara raa ku kou ake na hekau aia raa hakaatoa ki sui alaa tama, tena ki too na sileni raa no haere i taha. Aia e haere te henua e mmao roo, tena ki kaamata no tatahao puamu na sileni aia raa i na tiputipu sakkino.
Te taupeara raa e suisui na sileni aia raa no oti roo hakaatoa, tena te one raa ku tae ake i te henua raa, tena te taupeara raa ku se hai sileni roo e ttoe.
Tena aia ki haere no hehekau ma he tama i te henua raa. Kito te tama raa ki kauna te taupeara raa ki haere no rorohi na piki aia raa.
Te taupeara raa ku maanatu ma ki kai koi na kai na piki raa e kkai raa, e mee se hai tama e kou ake ni kai ki kai aia.
Tena te hakataakoto raa ku tere ake i te taupeara raa ma, ‘Na tama hehekau te tamana anau raa hakaatoa e kkai roo no ppohu, ia e isi koi na kai e ttoe, e meia anau ku taapiri koi ki mate taku hikai.
Anau e me ki mahike no haere te tamana anau raa no meake ma, “Tamana, anau ku sara roo i mua na karemata TeAtua ia ma na karemata akoe.
Anau ku se tau te mee pera ma he tama akoe, too anau mo tama koi hehekau akoe.” ’

Tena te taupeara raa ku mahike no vaakai muri i te tamana aia raa. “Te taupeara raa koi mmao roo i taha ma te hare raa te saaita te tamana aia raa ni kite aia, tena aia ku aroha roo i te taupeara aia raa, kito aia ki tere atu no avei te taupeara raa no mohoni.
Tena te taupeara raa ki meake, ‘Taku tamana, anau ku sara roo i mua na karemata TeAtua ia ma na karemata akoe. Anau ku se tau hoki te mee pera ma he tamariki akoe.’

Emeia te tamana aia raa e kanna ake na tama hehekau aia raa ma, ‘Vave! Kou mai na hekau taualleka raa no hakauru ake te tama nei. Taro ake he ring te matarima aia raa, tena ku hakauru ake ni taka i na vae aia raa.
Tena kootou ku oo no taa te pupunua bulmakau e rahi raa, tena taatou ku pena he kai e rahi ki hihhia taatou ma te tama nei!
Maitaname te tamariki anau nei ni mee raa ku mate, tena vahao nei aia ku ora muri; aia ni mee raa e rano, tena vahao nei aia ku vaakai mai.’ Tena na tama raa ku kaamata no kkai te kai raa.
“Ia te saaita naa te taupeara matua raa e noho i roto te paupaku. Tena te taupeara matua raa ku vaakai mai i hare, tena te saaita aia ku taapiri i hare raa, aia ku rono te rue ia ma na tama e llue.
Kito aia ki kanna ake te tama hehekau aia raa no vahiri ake ma, ‘Hea na tama raa e hai raa?’
Kito te tama hehekau raa ki meake, ‘Te taina akoe raa ku tae mai, tena te tamana akoe raa ki taa te pupunua bulmakau e rahi raa ki kkai taatou, e mee te taina akoe raa ku tae laoi mai.’
“Te taupeara matua raa ku roto roo, tena aia ku se hihai ki haere i roto hare; kito te tamana aia raa ki hamai i aho no hakorokoro te taupeara matua raa ki haere ake i hare.

Tena te taupeara raa ki meake te tamana aia raa ma, ‘Kira ake, na hetau nei hakaatoa anau e hehekau ma akoe pera ma he tama hehekau, tena anau se hai vahao roo e tattara sui na tattara akoe raa. Kaa hea akoe ni kou mai anau? Akoe se hai mee ni kou mai anau ma ki pena he kai ma na soa anau raa.
Emeia akoe e taa te pupunua bulmakau e rahi raa, te saaita te tama akoe e kanna ma he tamariki akoe raa ni tae mai, niaina roo ma te tama raa ni tahao puamu na sileni akoe raa i na hhine.’
Tena te tamana aia raa ki meake, ‘Taku tama, akoe e noho tahi ma anau, tena na mee hakaatoa anau e ttino raa ni mee akoe.
Emeia taatou e tau te kkai no hihhia, maitaname te taina akoe raa ni mee raa ku mate, e meia vahao nei aia ku ora muri; aia ni mee raa e rano, tena vahao nei aia ku vaakai mai.’ ”
